comments: The tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser; page content is never uploaded to a server. A free scan is available at https://limen.ae/app with no sign-up or account.
features: Exhibit A audits a web page against WCAG 2.1 Level A and AA in your browser, keeping confirmed failures separate from checks that need human judgement, so you never report a problem that is not there. Every finding cites the success criterion, the failing element and its source line, and exports as a dated report.
title: Exhibit A
